content.text: /ext:medcp In advanced CKD, which cardiovascular comorbidities are most frequent, and what mineral metabolism mechanisms could explain links?
I'll query the biomedical knowledge graph for information on cardiovascular comorbidities in advanced CKD and the mineral metabolism connections.

arguments.cypher_query:
MATCH (ckd:Disease {name: "Chronic Kidney Disease"})-[:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(cvd:Disease) 
RETURN cvd.name AS comorbidity, count(*) AS freq 
ORDER BY freq DESC LIMIT 20

MATCH (d:Disease)-[:HAS_MANIFESTATION]->(s:SymptomOrSign) 
WHERE toLower(d.name) CONTAINS "chronic kidney" OR toLower(d.name) CONTAINS "ckd"
WITH d LIMIT 1
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)<-[:ASSOCIATED_WITH]-(cv:Disease)-[:HAS_MANIFESTATION|AFFECTS]->(s)
RETURN distinct cv.name AS comorbidity

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT 
    c.diagnosis_code,
    d.description AS diagnosis_description,
    COUNT(*) AS frequency,
    CASE 
        WHEN c.diagnosis_code LIKE '40%' THEN 1
        WHEN c.diagnosis_code LIKE '41%' THEN 2
        WHEN c.diagnosis_code LIKE '42%' OR c.diagnosis_code LIKE '43%' THEN 3
        WHEN c.diagnosis_code LIKE '45%' OR c.diagnosis_code LIKE '48%' THEN 4
        ELSE 99
    END AS cardiovascular_category
FROM clinical_diagnoses c
JOIN diagnosis_description d ON c.diagnosis_code = d.code
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM patient_comorbidities p 
    JOIN ICD9_codes icd ON p.code_id = icd.code_id 
    WHERE p.patient_id = c.patient_id 
    AND icd.description LIKE '%chronic kidney disease%' 
    OR icd.description LIKE '%CKD%'
)
AND (d.description LIKE '%cardiovascular%' 
     OR d.description LIKE '%heart failure%' 
     OR d.description LIKE '%coronary artery%')
GROUP BY c.diagnosis_code, d.description
HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
ORDER BY frequency DESC LIMIT 25;
